chunks: Al-Khalil ibn Ahmad narrated to me, saying: Ibn Muni'a narrated to us, saying: Harun ibn Abdullah narrated to us, saying: Suleiman ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Dimashqi narrated to us, saying: Khalid ibn Abi Khalid al-Azraq narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman (and I suspect he is ibn Abi Layla), from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, from God's Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) that he said:
The best form of worship is jurisprudence (deep understanding), and the best aspect of religion is piety (God-consciousness).

key_terms.الدِّينُ: Religion; the complete system of faith and practice
key_terms.الْعِبَادَةُ: Worship; acts of devotion to God
key_terms.الْفِقْهُ: Jurisprudence; deep understanding of religious law and principles
key_terms.الْوَرَعُ: Piety; God-consciousness and vigilance against sin

ai.seo_question: What is considered the best form of worship and the most noble aspect of religion in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Khisal, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights this hadith to emphasize that intellectual depth (fiqh) is the superior act of worship, while moral integrity (war') constitutes the essence of religious character. This distinction underscores the Shia emphasis on the inseparable link between doctrinal understanding and ethical conduct as the dual pillars of a complete faith.
